As per the Hindu calendar, Purushottam Mas (also known as Adhik Maas) is considered highly auspicious, allowing the celebration of all religious festivals and observances during this extra month. Swamishri celebrates Akshaya Tritiya, a day considered auspicious for new beginnings, and also marks the commencement of Thakorji's sandalwood adornments. Hence, Swamishri is seen creating sandalwood paste
